title: What If You Jumped on a Comet?

scenes.text: What if you jumped on a comet? You might never come back down.
Comet 67P is only a few kilometers wide, so its gravity is tiny.
Escape speed there is about one to two miles an hour, slower than a walk.
On Earth, escape speed is about 25,000 miles an hour.
In 2014, Europe's lander Philae touched down, and its harpoons failed to fire.
It bounced more than a kilometer high, and finally stopped two hours after first touching down.
